# Support Guidelines (支持指南)

English | [简体中文](#简体中文)

## English Version

### Getting Help
Thank you for using Ought Gather! If you run into issues or have questions, here are the best ways to get support:

1. **Search Existing Issues:** Before opening a new issue, please search the [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/liusonwood/oughtgather/issues) and [Discussions](https://github.com/liusonwood/oughtgather/discussions) to see if your question has already been answered.
2. **Consult the Documentation:** Most common setup and configuration questions are covered in our documentation:
   - [CONFIG.md](../docs/CONFIG.md) — Detailed configuration guide.
   - [OPERATIONS.md](../docs/OPERATIONS.md) — Maintenance and troubleshooting.
   - [TESTING.md](../docs/TESTING.md) — How to run tests.
3. **GitHub Discussions:** For general questions, ideas, or sharing your setup, please use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/liusonwood/oughtgather/discussions).
4. **GitHub Issues:** For bug reports or specific feature requests, please use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/liusonwood/oughtgather/issues). Please use the provided templates.

---

## 简体中文

### 获取支持
感谢您使用 Ought Gather！如果您在运行过程中遇到问题或有任何疑问，请通过以下渠道获取支持：

1. **搜索现有 Issue**：在发起新的咨询之前，请先搜索 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/liusonwood/oughtgather/issues) 和 [Discussions](https://github.com/liusonwood/oughtgather/discussions)，查看您的问题是否已经有了现成的答案。
2. **查阅项目文档**：绝大多数关于部署和配置的问题都可以在文档中找到答案：
   - [CONFIG.md](../docs/CONFIG.md) — 详细的配置指南。
   - [OPERATIONS.md](../docs/OPERATIONS.md) — 运维与故障排查。
   - [TESTING.md](../docs/TESTING.md) — 如何运行测试。
3. **GitHub Discussions**：对于一般性的提问、想法建议或分享您的配置心得，请使用 [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/liusonwood/oughtgather/discussions)。
4. **GitHub Issues**：对于明确的 Bug 报告或功能申请，请使用 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/liusonwood/oughtgather/issues)，并请务必使用预设的 Issue 模板。
